inputs: exact previously verified original calibration12, seed42+original index; no task0/task6 or formal image fitting
scope: all40 blocks at all4 native steps, high0/1 and low2/3
sampling: uniform without replacement over observed rows; deterministic per input, step and block; save actual grid/rows/pi
no_op: same initialized dense pipeline, fresh seeded plain generation then hooked generation per input; compare all4 FP32 poststep latent byte hashes and video hashes; do not claim fresh-process comparison
storage: node-local Hugging Face derived cache, full SHA per scope; 80GiB disk reserve; two disjoint six-input GPU shards
planned_fit: per-position C mean with each input equally weighted; static top108 groups64; centered bias-free signal LS gain and mean residual folded into b2 once
gain: alpha=max(0,sum((s-mean_s)*gate*(y-mean_y)*gate)/sum(((s-mean_s)*gate)^2)); s/y are FP32 sparse/dense bias-free signals
bias_correction: b2_new=BF16(b2+mean_y-alpha*mean_s); apply alpha after Q2 then BF16 before reduced FFN2
selection: fixed C-static+centered-gain+bias is the next reference; unit/gain-only/random are controls, no validation selection
evaluation: first existing task0/task6 block20 independent-source local diagnostic, then full160 closed loop; all-row/static costs counted in later deployment
acceptance: training capture, local risks, sparse numerical checks and video/true full FFN timing are separate; no acceptance claim from this collection
